xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4917: CI trailer gate times out on full-history checkout; cancelled check blocks merges and conflict repair

plan.title: CI trailer gate times out on full-history checkout; cancelled check blocks merges and conflict repair
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The CI job 'Prompt change trailer gate' checks out with fetch-depth: 0 under a 5-minute cap. fetch-depth: 0 fetches all ~716 branches and ~588 tags, including the archived overdeck-state branch (~195k commits, ~391k trees not on main), so the checkout sometimes takes over 5 minutes and the job is cancelled (main run 41686923189, PRs #4911 and #4915 on 2026-11-03). A job killed by its own timeout reports conclusion CANCELLED, which makes the head red, and evaluateConflictRepairGate declines repair for any red head, so approved conflicting PRs #4911 and #4915 never got a sync-main repair. The decline reason did not name the red check.
narratives.Proposal: (1) Give scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh a --fetch mode that fetches only main and HEAD, blobless and tagless, unshallowing a shallow clone, and fails loudly if the clone stays shallow or origin/main is missing; extend its --self-test with file:// shallow-clone cases. (2) Make the CI prompt-gate job a one-commit checkout that runs the script with --fetch, with timeout-minutes 20. (3) Move per-check failure listing into a new leaf module cloister/check-failures.ts (listFailedChecks, listFailedTestChecks, FailedCheck, re-exported from pr-facts.ts so pr-facts.ts shrinks under the file-size ceiling) and add PrFacts.checkFailures for GitHub. (4) In evaluateConflictRepairGate, a red head whose failing checks all concluded CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT or STALE no longer declines repair; any other failure still declines, and the reason names every failing check with its conclusion. (5) Document both changes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change lint-group (core)'s fetch-depth: 0 checkout (PAN-2227); it is a possible follow-up.
- Do not change the merge gate (evaluateMergeReadiness, evaluateIssueMergeGate) or summarizeStatusCheckRollup: a cancelled check still blocks merging and still makes checks 'red'.
- Do not automatically re-run cancelled checks.
- Do not change the pan reload rule that refuses a cancelled main CI run.
- Do not add GitLab per-job check detail; a red GitLab head still declines repair.
- Do not change which files the trailer script watches or its trailer regex, and do not change npm run lint:prompt-trailer.
- Do not rename the CI job's display name 'Prompt change trailer gate'.
- Do not fetch, modify or delete the overdeck-state branch.
- Do not write tests that read ci.yml or source text to assert its shape.
- Do not fix the no-argument script's existing missing-base-ref path (exit 128); CI with --fetch asserts origin/main first.
- Do not fall back to fetch-depth: 0 in the prompt-gate job under any circumstance.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a targeted blobless fetch of main and HEAD (script --fetch mode) instead of the issue's option of fetch-depth: 0 plus filter: blob:none
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured at planning time: fetch-depth: 0 fetches every branch, and overdeck-state alone is ~195k commits and ~391k trees, so blob:none still sends ~700k objects. main plus HEAD blobless is ~118k objects / ~16 MiB and does not grow with branch count. The issue's own fix direction allows 'or fetch only what the script needs'. A prototype passed on a file:// shallow clone.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the fetch in the script, not inline in the workflow YAML
autoDecisions.rationale: One source of truth that the script's --self-test (already run by tests/unit/scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.test.ts in CI) can exercise; source-grep tests of ci.yml are rejected by repo lint.

autoDecisions.summary: Raise the job's timeout-minutes from 5 to 20
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the same headroom as peers; build and lint-group use 20 (test shards use 30), and 20 keeps the PAN-1651 wall-clock cap meaningful for a job this small.

autoDecisions.summary: Treat CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT and STALE check conclusions as 'not run' for conflict repair only
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified that a job killed by timeout-minutes reports conclusion cancelled, identical to a superseded run, so the rule must be by conclusion. Such checks judged nothing; the repair pushes a new head that CI runs again, and the unchanged merge gate re-judges CI there. PAN-4451 already waives pending/absent CI in this gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Decline reasons keep the prefix 'CI checks failing on PR HEAD <sha>' and append ': <name> (<CONCLUSION>), ...'
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's minimum ask is that the reason names the red check; keeping the prefix keeps the existing test and log readers stable.
pr-facts.ts is 988 lines against the 1000-line ceiling; extraction shrinks it and keeps every existing import working through re-exports.

autoDecisions.summary: Rename the CI step (not the job) to name the flywheel skill instead of docs/flywheel-brief.md
autoDecisions.rationale: The script watches sync-sources/skills/pan-flywheel/SKILL.md; the step name was stale. The job name is the rollup check name and must stay.

items.title: Add a --fetch mode and its self-test cases to the prompt trailer script

expected_outputs: the no-argument run in the workspace exits 0 with the same output as before the change

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4917.md) exactly. Edit only scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh. (1) Add the fetch_history function from the PRD after resolve_merge_base: it derives remote and branch from BASE_REF, adds --unshallow only when `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` prints true, runs `git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none [--unshallow] <remote> +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch> "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"` INSIDE `if ! git fetch ...; then fail "history fetch failed from $remote"; exit 1; fi` (the script runs under set -e, so a bare failing fetch would exit 128 without our message), then calls fail and exits 1 if the clone is still shallow or BASE_REF does not resolve. (2) Add the `--fetch` dispatch before the final `check` call, after the existing --self-test dispatch. (3) In self_test add `git branch no-trailer` right after the commit 'update flywheel prompt', and after the third scenario add the PRD's block: checkout main, set uploadpack.allowFilter and uploadpack.allowReachableSHA1InWant, loop over no-trailer:fail topic:pass main:pass cloning `--depth 1 --branch <b> file://$tmp $tmp/clone-<b>`, asserting the clone is shallow, running the script with --fetch, comparing pass/fail, asserting the clone is no longer shallow; then the clone-broken case (origin set to file://$tmp/missing must exit exactly 1 and its output must contain 'prompt-trailer: history fetch failed'). Clones stay inside $tmp; add no new rm commands. The no-argument check path must stay byte-for-byte the same in behavior. A scratch prototype of exactly this code passed --self-test at planning time.

items.title: Given the edited script, when `bash scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh --self-test` runs, then it prints 'prompt-trailer: self-test passed' and exits 0 after the no-trailer:fail, topic:pass, main:pass and clone-broken cases

Given a shallow file:// clone of a branch that changes roles/*.md without a Prompt-Change trailer, when the script runs with --fetch, then it exits 1 printing 'prompt-trailer: FAILED' and `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` in that clone prints false
Given a shallow clone whose origin points at a missing repository, when the script runs with --fetch, then it exits 1 and prints 'prompt-trailer: history fetch failed'
When the script runs with no argument in a full local clone, then it prints the same 'prompt-trailer:' lines and exits with the same code as the origin/main version of the script
Switch the CI prompt-gate job to a one-commit checkout plus the script's --fetch

expected_outputs: the diff touches only the prompt-gate job: timeout-minutes 20, no fetch-depth: 0, run line ends with --fetch, step renamed

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Edit only the prompt-gate job in .github/workflows/ci.yml (grep anchor 'name: Prompt change trailer gate') to the PRD's 'After' block: keep `name: Prompt change trailer gate` unchanged (it is the rollup check name), set `timeout-minutes: 20` with the PAN-1651/PAN-4917 comment, make the checkout a plain `- uses: actions/checkout@v4` with no `with:` block and the PAN-4917 comment, rename the step to 'Check Prompt-Change trailer for roles/ and the flywheel skill', and run `bash scripts/check-prompt-change-trailer.sh --fetch`. Touch no other job. PUSH OVER SSH: the gh OAuth token lacks the workflow scope, so push with `git push git@github.com:eltmon/overdeck.git HEAD:feature/pan-4917`. After CI runs on the PR, read the job log and timing (`gh pr checks <pr> --json name,state,startedAt,completedAt` or `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/commits/<head>/check-runs`). FALLBACK (implementation checkpoint): if the log shows `not our ref` for the SHA want, keep the fetch targeted: in fetch_history replace the last fetch argument with `"${PROMPT_CHANGE_FETCH_REF:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"` and give the CI step `env: PROMPT_CHANGE_FETCH_REF: ${{ github.ref }}`, re-run the self-test, and confirm the timing bound. NEVER fall back to fetch-depth: 0 (with or without filter: blob:none); it fetches overdeck-state again. Record the fallback and error text in the PR body.
